title: Chemical modification of selenium-containing amino acids caused by non-thermal dielectric-barrier discharge atmospheric-pressure plasma
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38094-38104
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05754F, Paper
Open Access

Fahd Afzal, Dariusz Śmiłowicz, Friederike Kogelheide, Anna Lena Schöne, Katharina Stapelmann, Peter Awakowicz, Nils Metzler-Nolte
Herein, we present an investigation of the chemical modifications of selenium-containing amino acids which are caused by non-thermal plasma in the presence of redox active iron complexes as well as a redox inert zinc complex.
